claims.head: Patience vs. Spray-and-pray
claims.body: On shot quality, St. Louis is one of the league’s best, but Chicago is near the bottom. The more dangerous chances should be the Blues’.

CHI.head: The Blackhawks have a hill to climb
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, St. Louis has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks’ best way through is a penalty kill that holds up.
